newsitem.title: USA: USDA to announce CRP proposal next week - Stenholm.
newsitem.headline: USDA to announce CRP proposal next week - Stenholm.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman will announce new proposed rules for the Conservation Reserve Program next week, a leading Democratic Congressman said Thursday.
"They will be out next week and it is about time," said Charles Stenholm of Texas, ranking minority member of the U.S. House Agriculture Committee.
He told reporters at the National Cattlemen's Beef Association annual convention here that he had talked to Glickman about the proposals on Wednesday
Stenholm declined to comment further and suggested questions should be directed to Glickman when he visits the convention on Friday.
Republican Bob Smith of Oregon, chairman of the House Agriculture Committee, said the issue needed to be resolved quickly as some land was due to come out of the program by March 1.
"We have a 60-day waiting period (for comment). Hopefully we can suspend that," he told reporters.
